summary.name: Spyne
summary.one_liner: Spyne is an AI platform for used-car dealerships and marketplaces that creates vehicle listings, 360° views and customer engagement tools.
use_cases: Creating 360° vehicle views for listing pages
Resolving sales and service inquiries automatically
Reducing days a vehicle sits on the lot
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Spyne as a tool that helps dealerships go from vehicle acquisition to a live listing quickly, with day-zero listings and premium merchandising. It also lists AI-driven customer engagement features that resolve sales and service inquiries and follow up to book appointments. The page names two products, Vini AI and Studio AI, but does not describe what either one does. Specific capabilities beyond the listing summary (such as how the 360° views are produced) are not detailed in the page text.
notable: Two named products: Vini AI and Studio AI
Targets day-zero listings and lower days-on-lot
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Page is mostly marketing claims with few technical details
Listed as paid in the source list
